welcome.message: Hello, I am Jana AI. I can help you prepare for travel, handle immigration situations, and connect you with legal support. How can I help today?

travel_intake.message: Let's prepare your travel case. What visa type are you traveling on?

airport_live.message: I understand this can be stressful. Stay calm. Tell me what is happening right now.

detained.message: Stay calm. I am creating a high-priority case and notifying support.

notice_received.message: Please upload the notice document. I will help classify the situation and connect you with support if needed.

lawyer_assigned.message: A lawyer has been assigned to your case. You will receive consultation details shortly.

case_resolved.message: Your case has been marked as resolved. You can still review the timeline and documents anytime.
